lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho₂Ti₈Sn₄ (reduced formula HoTi₄Sn₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two tetrahedral motifs: Ho centers with four Sn neighbors and Sn centers with four Ti neighbors, both at 3.0239 Å, while Ti centers coordinate to two Ho and two Sn neighbors at the same distance. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ho and Sn tetrahedra, as well as corner-sharing among Ti tetrahedra.
